column1: # 6 地図に描かれないもの

column1: # 7 直せる道具の条件

column1: <S>These changes</S> <V>would not remove</V> <O>every difference in background</O>, <M>and the organizers should not pretend that a brief lesson makes years of experience irrelevant</M>.

column1: <S>They</S> <V>could nevertheless reduce</V> <O>a mismatch between the event's invitation and the conditions under which newcomers are asked to perform</O>.

column1: <S>Registration information</S> <V>could describe</V> <O>the expected preparation</O> <M>with examples, so that a newcomer could decide whether the event offered an appropriate challenge before committing time to it</M>.

column3: so thatは目的、whether節がdecideのO、before doingは参加に先立つ判断。

column2: 開催前に参加を考える人から出る質問で、プログラミングの概念を既に理解している想定など、一見簡単な指示に隠れた前提も分かりうる。

column1: <S>Keeping those conditions explicit</S> <V>also allows</V> <O>experienced participants to see that their achievements are being interpreted under stated criteria rather than discounted without explanation</O>.

column3: 動名詞句がS、keep O C。allow O to do、are being interpretedは進行形受動、discountedと対比。

column1: <S>Fairness</S> <V>therefore involves</V> <O>more than either identical inputs or equal results</O>; <S>it</S> <V>requires</V> <O>an account of what the competition is for</O>.

column1: <S>Consistent rules</S> <V>remain</V> <C>important</C>, <M>but their significance depends partly on whether they create the opportunities that the invitation reasonably leads people to expect</M>.

column1: <S>A useful evaluation</S> <V>would ask</V> <O>who could participate meaningfully, what the scores represented, and how the stated purposes shaped the design</O>.

column1: <S>It</S> <V>would not assume</V> <O>that every unequal result proves unfairness or that one uniform rule settles all questions about opportunity</O>.

column1: <S>The goal</S> <V>is</V> <C>a defensible relationship between the event's purpose, its procedures, and the meaning assigned to its results</C>.
